metadata.name: The Hollow Kingdom — Merewatch by Lamplight

items.name: Ferryman's Hanger
items.description: A short blade with a worn leather grip. Oswin used to cut fouled ferry ropes with it.

items.name: Beacon Key
items.description: Salt has turned the bronze green. A little beacon is stamped on the bow.

items.name: Watchkeeper's Letter
items.description: For my father, at the winding well. The wax carries the watchtower seal.

items.name: Ferry Penny
items.description: The old Merewatch fare. A lantern on one face, an oar on the other.

quests.name: The Last Watch
quests.description: Oswin's daughter keeps the beacon. Her signal is overdue.

objectives.description: Take Oswin's hanger. Equip it in Inventory (I).
Defeat Pine Lookout at the lamplit camp east of the cottage lane.
Defeat Ash Coat at the lamplit camp east of the cottage lane.
Search the poachers' coffer for the Beacon Key.
Sail from the village dock and find the letter by the watchtower.
Return to Oswin at the well and hand him the letter.

quests.completionMessage: The Last Watch complete. Oswin pays you twelve ferry pennies.

quests.name: The Beacon Trail
quests.description: Follow Oswin's directions to the beacon across the mere.

objectives.description: Hear Oswin's account of the beacon.
Reach the watchtower across the mere.

quests.completionMessage: The Beacon Trail complete. You reached the watchtower.

data.message: Find the Beacon Key in the poachers’ coffer.

cutscenes.name: The Light Across the Mere
cutscenes.text: That's her light, up there. Three nights now and she hasn't shuttered it.

cues.speaker: Oswin
cues.text: Look for the light across the mere. Mara tends it.

cues.speaker: Oswin
cues.text: Follow the jetty lantern. She leaves word at the foot of the tower.

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: See the light across the mere? My daughter keeps the watch now. I leave this lamp burning till she shutters hers.

choices.text: Where did they take the key?
I have the key. Where do I land?

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: Three nights burning. She leaves word at the tower, but two poachers took my beacon key. I can lend you my boat if you'll go.

choices.text: Lend me a blade. I'll bring back word.

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: Take my hanger. Open Inventory (I) and equip it. Turn back down the cottage lane and take the dirt track east to their lamp. Face them and press F to strike.

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: Their coffer is under a lamp in the southeast pines. Take the dirt fork at the cottage end of the lane. My mare grazes east of the well if you'd sooner ride.

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: My boat's at the end of our dock. Make for the lantern on the jetty left of the tower. Mara keeps the dispatch box uphill, at the foot of the beacon.

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: ‘Keep your lamp in the window.’ Oh, Mara. As if I'd ever let it go out. Keep the hanger, friend, and take these twelve pennies for the crossing.

nodes.speaker: Oswin
nodes.text: I've read it so many times the crease is wearing through. Still a good bright light up there.
A heavy oak coffer sits in the lamplight. You need both poachers out of the way to search it.

choices.text: Lift the lid and take the key.

nodes.speaker: Poachers' Coffer
nodes.text: A bronze key and three ferry pennies lie under the loose cloth. Time to take Oswin's boat across the mere.

nodes.speaker: Poachers' Coffer
nodes.text: You leave the coffer where it lies.

nodes.speaker: Keeper’s dispatch box
nodes.text: A little iron lock holds the lid against the wind. Someone has cut a lamp into the wood.

nodes.speaker: Mara’s letter
nodes.text: Father — three horns in the dark, but no boats. I’ve barred the stair and lit the second wick. Keep your lamp in the window. — M.
It holds fast. You need the beacon key.
Only grit and a broken stick of red sealing wax remain.
